# Kenney Game Icons (CC0)

Copied from the user-provided Kenney Game Icons package on 2026-11-02.
`white-2x/` retains the 105 original white 2× PNG icons for future UI changes.
`license.txt` is the original CC0 licence; `preview.png` is the original pack preview.
Author: Kenney Vleugels, https://kenney.nl.

The runtime uses a 16-icon atlas, not the entire directory. Regenerate it with
`npm run icons:ui`; the selected files and atlas order live in
`src/game/ui/iconCatalog.ts`. No access to the original Downloads directory is needed.
